items.title: Why Palantir Stock (PLTR) Is Still a Buy After Its Q3 Pullback

In Q3, the Florida-based software company delivered yet another beat across the board. Revenue reached $2.31 billion, while adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $0.44, beating expectations by 6% and 8.4%, respectively.
